assessment: The bench is 21 fair conditional bodies; the maindeck already sleeves the verified engines (stacks 001, 003, 004, 005). Four bench cards earn Short List slots by plugging into those engines. Six pool cards demonstrably beat the bench tail — Terror of the Peaks over Goring Ceratops, Aggravated Assault over Rampaging Brontodon, Goblin Bombardment over Sunfrill Imitator, Repercussion over Zetalpa, Primal Dawn, Three Visits over Knight of the Stampede, Farseek over Earthshaker Dreadmaw — each on an index-backed or engine-extension claim the tail cannot match. The floor is 4 on the combo DB's infinite tag for Polyraptor + Forerunner of the Empire; stack 003 verifies that exact pair as a bounded, self-terminating burst of at most seven tokens, so no pick below moves the computed floor.

ten.why: The deck reliably hurts it: the enrage engine is drawn 72.6% by turn 6 (goldfish), and under the stack-005 ping web each optional Forerunner of the Empire ping would read 'put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control' — permanent counters that harden the fragile 1/3 Forerunner hub, while under the stack-004 one-sided Blasphemous Act its 1 damage turns the sweep into a team anthem; the anthem-per-ping composite and Aegisaur's own survival budget mid-burst need a stack scenario.
ten.when: Web-centric pods — damage-sweeper and attrition tables — as a trial sleeve until the survival-budget scenario runs.

citations.quote: buy resilience instead of restraint where you can

combo_lines_opened.produces: Infinite death triggers, Infinite ETB, Infinite LTB

ten.why: Every Gishath connect dumps Dinosaurs onto the battlefield (stack 001 verifies the cascade), and Terror converts each one into damage equal to its power at any target — a seven-power reveal off one swing becomes a kill shot at a creature or a face; it is off-tribe (the reveal skips it, Urza's Incubator will not discount it), which is the honest cost of the strongest payoff in the pool.
ten.unlocks: A wincon the role budget says the deck lacks (wincon -3), plus the Polyraptor damage loop — needs a stack scenario before any infinite claim.

citations.quote: late-game threat assessment collapses to "does this card win the game if it resolves,"

combo_lines_opened.produces: Infinite colored mana, Infinite combat phases, Infinite untap of creatures you control, Infinite mana creatures you control can produce

ten.why: Gishath's reveal triggers on every combat damage, so each {3}{R}{R} activation is a second connect per turn — the fair mode alone doubles the deck's verified payoff (stack 001) — and Selvala, Heart of the Wilds tapping for a big-power board plausibly pays the activation each combat for the flagged infinite.
ten.unlocks: Extra Gishath connects every turn, and the Selvala infinite-combat line — needs a stack scenario.

ten.why: A second Nature's Lore: an untapped Forest-typed land — including Canopy Vista, Cinder Glade, or Jetmir's Garden — on turn 2 instead of Kodama's Reach's turn 3, in a 35-land deck whose commander's mean goldfish cast is turn 7.969; every turn shaved off the ramp step is a turn off that number.
ten.unlocks: The turn-2 ramp start the curve principle demands and the bench cannot offer.

citations.quote: Build to hit 2, 4 and 6 mana reliably, because four-player turn cycles are expensive

ten.why: Turn-2 ramp that fetches the non-Forest half of the mana base — Canopy Vista, Cinder Glade, Jetmir's Garden, Clifftop Retreat's shock-typed peers are out of reach of Forest ramp — fixing the W and R pips (23 and 19 total pips) that Gishath's {5}{R}{G}{W} cost and Wakening Sun's Avatar's {W}{W}{W} demand.
ten.unlocks: W/R pip fixing on turn 2 that the deck's Forest-only ramp package cannot provide.

combo_lines_opened.produces: Infinite death triggers, Infinite ETB, Infinite LTB, Infinite sacrifice triggers

ten.why: The free sacrifice outlet the 99 lacks: stack 002 verifies that Marauding Raptor + Polyraptor is a mandatory loop that draws the whole game precisely because nothing can break it — Bombardment is the loop-breaker class, and in fair play it converts each stack-003 burst token into a ping that re-arms the enrage web.
ten.unlocks: A loop-breaker, a repeatable enrage enabler, and the Polyraptor sacrifice line — needs a stack scenario.

ten.why: The deck already runs the verified one-sided Blasphemous Act (stack 004: your Dinosaurs each take 1 under Temple Altisaur) — add Repercussion and the same sweep should deal 13 to each opponent per creature they control while your side reflects 1s; whether Temple's reduction and Wrathful Raptors' redirect interact with Repercussion the way that sketch assumes needs a stack scenario.
ten.unlocks: A table-kill mode bolted onto a sweep the deck already casts — needs a stack scenario.

ten.why: With the ping web in the 99, each optional Forerunner ping should read 'this 10/10 fights up to one target creature you don't control', and fight-back damage should chain its own enrage for a second fight — repeatable removal on every Dinosaur ETB, bounded by its 10-toughness budget; the chain needs a stack scenario.
ten.when: Creature-mirror pods where repeatable fights outbid another top-end body; at {7}{G}{G} against 5.486 mean available mana at turn 6, it is a late sleeve.

ten.why: Each optional Forerunner ping should make each opponent sacrifice a permanent of their choice — a repeatable triple edict per Dinosaur ETB that answers hexproof and protection boards targeted removal cannot touch; the composite needs a stack scenario.
ten.when: Pods where boards hide behind hexproof, ward, or indestructible and edicts are the only removal that connects.

ten.why: Each 5-toughness Polyraptor token of a verified stack-003 burst is 5 life — up to 35 off one ETB chain — and every Gishath reveal pays it again; it rebuilds nothing after a wrath, which is why it is a meta sleeve and not a default.
ten.when: Racing and burn pods where life total is the axis the table attacks.

gaps: No bench card has an EDHREC rank (sideboard-facts note), so every bench verdict rests on the deck's needs, the five passing stacks, and oracle text rather than popularity.

The computed floor 4 rests on the combo DB's infinite tag for Polyraptor + Forerunner of the Empire, which stack 003 verifies as bounded at seven tokens and self-terminating; the bracket engine does not consult passing stacks, so every delta above reads 4 -> 4 with the verified-reality argument for 3 on record.

Five scenarios would settle the list's open claims, one rules domain each: Bellowing Aegisaur's survival budget under multi-ping; Terror of the Peaks x Polyraptor; Aggravated Assault x Selvala; Repercussion x Blasphemous Act under Temple Altisaur and Wrathful Raptors; Goblin Bombardment as breaker of the stack-002 loop.

The role budget's draw shortfall (-4) has no index-backed pool answer: the obsolescence index offers Harmonize over Rishkar's Expertise, rejected on oracle text — Expertise scales with Ghalta's 12 power and drops a free permanent, which Harmonize's flat three cards is not an upgrade over. A draw-package scout needs another evidence channel.
The provisional 36-land budget reads the deck's 35 lands as short by one — inside noise, and no pick below rests on a land-count argument.
The strategy corpus has no section on typal construction or enrage/self-damage engines; the citations above lean on curve, wrath-math, and pivot-window principles instead.
